alternate_extra_wall.description: Add an extra wall on alternating layers to improve layer bonding and part strength without the full cost of a permanent extra wall.

apply_scarf_seam_on_circles.description: Scarf seam will be applied on circles for better dimensional accuracy.

auxiliary_fan.description: Enable this option if machine has auxiliary part cooling fan
auxiliary_fan.label: Auxiliary part cooling fan

avoid_crossing_wall_includes_support.description: Including support while avoiding crossing wall.
avoid_crossing_wall_includes_support.label: Avoid crossing wall - Includes support

bed_exclude_area.description: Unprintable area in XY plane. For example, X1 Series printers use the front left corner to cut filament during filament change. The area is expressed as polygon by points in following format: "XxY, XxY, ..."
bed_exclude_area.label: Bed exclude area

bed_temperature_formula.description: This option determines how the bed temperature is set during slicing: based on the temperature of the first filament or the highest temperature of the printed filaments.
bed_temperature_formula.label: Bed temperature type

before_layer_change_gcode.description: This G-code is inserted at every layer change before lifting z
before_layer_change_gcode.label: Before layer change G-code

best_object_pos.description: Best auto arranging position in range [0,1] w.r.t. bed shape.
best_object_pos.label: Best object position

bottom_color_penetration_layers.description: This is the number of layers of bottom paint penetration.
bottom_color_penetration_layers.label: Bottom paint penetration layers

bottom_shell_layers.description: This is the number of solid layers of bottom shell, including the bottom surface layer. When the thickness calculated by this value is thinner than bottom shell thickness, the bottom shell layers will be increased
bottom_shell_layers.label: Bottom shell layers

bottom_shell_thickness.description: The number of bottom solid layers is increased when slicing if the thickness calculated by bottom shells layers is thinner than this value. This can avoid having too thin shell when layer height is small. 0 means that this setting is disabled and thickness of bottom shell is absolutely determained by bottom shell layers
bottom_shell_thickness.label: Bottom shell thickness

bottom_surface_density.description: Density of bottom surface infill, 100% means a fully solid filled top layer.Lower values create a textured bottom surface, Intended for aesthetic or functional purposes, not to fix issues such as over-extrusion.WARNING: Lowering this value may negatively affect bed adhesion.
bottom_surface_density.label: Bottom surface density

bottom_surface_pattern.description: Line pattern of bottom surface infill, not bridge infill
bottom_surface_pattern.label: Bottom surface pattern

bridge_angle.description: Bridging angle override. If left to zero, the bridging angle will be calculated automatically. Otherwise the provided angle will be used for external bridges. Use 180°for zero angle.
bridge_angle.label: Bridge direction

bridge_flow.description: Decrease this value slightly(for example 0.9) to reduce the amount of material for bridge, to improve sag
bridge_flow.label: Bridge flow

bridge_no_support.description: Don't support the whole bridge area which makes support very large. Bridge usually can be printing directly without support if not very long
bridge_no_support.label: Don't support bridges

bridge_speed.description: Speed of bridge and completely overhang wall
bridge_speed.label: Bridge

brim_object_gap.description: A gap between innermost brim line and object can make brim be removed more easily
brim_object_gap.label: Brim-object gap

brim_type.description: This controls the generation of the brim at outer and/or inner side of models. Auto means the brim width is analysed and calculated automatically.
brim_type.label: Brim type

brim_width.description: Distance from model to the outermost brim line
brim_width.label: Brim width

chamber_temperatures.description: Higher chamber temperature can help suppress or reduce warping and potentially lead to higher interlayer bonding strength for high temperature materials like ABS, ASA, PC, PA and so on.At the same time, the air filtration of ABS and ASA will get worse.While for PLA, PETG, TPU, PVA and other low temperature materials,the actual chamber temperature should not be high to avoid cloggings, so 0 which stands for turning off is highly recommended
chamber_temperatures.label: Chamber temperature

change_filament_gcode.description: This gcode is inserted when change filament, including T command to trigger tool change
change_filament_gcode.label: Change filament G-code

circle_compensation_manual_offset.description: If you want to have tighter or looser assemble, you can set this value. When it is positive, it indicates tightening, otherwise, it indicates loosening
circle_compensation_manual_offset.label: User Customized Offset

close_additional_fan_first_x_layers.description: Set special auxiliary cooling fan for the first certain layers.
close_additional_fan_first_x_layers.label: For the first

close_fan_the_first_x_layers.description: Set special cooling fan for the first certain layers.The part cooling fan of the first layer used to be closed to get better build plate adhesion and used for auto cooling function
close_fan_the_first_x_layers.label: For the first

complete_print_exhaust_fan_speed.description: Speed of exhuast fan after printing completes
complete_print_exhaust_fan_speed.label: Fan speed

conformal_infill.description: Make sparse infill follow each layer's outline instead of using one set of parallel lines. On elongated or curved shapes, lines radiate from a center. Applies to Zig Zag, Cross Zag, Rectilinear, Aligned Rectilinear, and Locked Zag skin.
conformal_infill.label: Conformal infill

conformal_link_flip_layers.description: Number of consecutive layers that reverse the zigzag (start from the opposite rim). 0 disables reversing. Forward 1 and Reverse 1 reverses every other layer.
conformal_link_flip_layers.label: Reverse layers

conformal_link_keep_layers.description: Number of consecutive layers that keep the forward zigzag. Together with Reverse layers this repeats: N forward, then M reversed. 0 means reverse from the first layer.
conformal_link_keep_layers.label: Forward layers

conformal_pole.description: Where the radial center comes from. Each layer picks a center on that slice. Axis fits one 3D line through those centers. Smooth curve fits a curve so the center does not jump between layers.
conformal_pole.label: Radial center

conformal_ray_count.description: How many radial lines around the center. 0 uses the count from sparse infill density. A positive value is the radial line count, rounded up to an even number of at least 4.
conformal_ray_count.label: Radial line count

conformal_stagger.description: How neighboring layers are offset. Off stacks the same layout. Alternate keeps the same line directions but connects each line to the neighboring one on the opposite side, which improves interlayer bonding.
conformal_stagger.label: Layer stagger

cool_plate_temp.description: Bed temperature for layers except the initial one. Value 0 means the filament does not support to print on the Cool Plate
cool_plate_temp.label: Other layers

cool_plate_temp_initial_layer.description: Bed temperature of the initial layer. Value 0 means the filament does not support to print on the Cool Plate
cool_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: Initial layer

cooling_filter_enabled.description: Enable this if printer support cooling filter
cooling_filter_enabled.label: Use cooling filter

cooling_perimeter_transition_distance.description:
Distance in millimeters before the end of slowed perimeters where the original print speed is gradually restored. This reduces quality issues when transitioning from slowed features to fast external perimeter printing.

Only applies when 'Consistent surface' cooling logic is selected.
Recommended value: 5-10mm. Set to 0 to disable.
cooling_perimeter_transition_distance.label: Perimeter transition distance

cooling_slowdown_logic.description:
Determines how the printer slows down when minimum layer time isn't reached.

'Uniform cooling' slows down all print features equally (current default behavior).

'Consistent surface' prioritizes slowing infill and internal perimeters first, preserving external perimeter speed for better surface finish on glossy filaments. This helps reduce VFA (Vertical Fine Artifacts) and maintains consistent surface shine.
cooling_slowdown_logic.label: Cooling slowdown logic

counterbore_hole_bridging.description:
This option creates bridges for counterbore holes, allowing them to be printed without support. Available modes include:
1. None: No bridge is created
2. Partially Bridged: Only a part of the unsupported area will be bridged
3. Sacrificial Layer: A full sacrificial bridge layer is created
counterbore_hole_bridging.label: Bridge counterbore holes

curr_bed_type.description: Bed types supported by the printer
curr_bed_type.label: Bed type

default_acceleration.description: The default acceleration of both normal printing and travel except initial layer
default_acceleration.label: Normal printing

default_ams_type.description: The default AMS type used to estimate filament load/unload time, stored as the AMS timing type enum value. It comes from the printer preset and does not reflect the AMS currently attached to the machine.
default_ams_type.label: Default AMS type

default_filament_profile.description: Default filament profile when switch to this machine profile
default_filament_profile.label: Default filament profile

default_nozzle_volume_type.description: Default Nozzle volume type for extruders in this printer
default_nozzle_volume_type.label: Default Nozzle Volume Type

default_print_profile.description: Default process profile when switch to this machine profile
default_print_profile.label: Default process profile

deretraction_speed.description: Speed for reloading filament into extruder. Zero means the same speed as retraction
deretraction_speed.label: Deretraction Speed

detect_floating_vertical_shell.description: Detect overhang paths in vertical shells and slow them by bridge speed.
detect_floating_vertical_shell.label: Detect floating vertical shells

detect_narrow_internal_solid_infill.description: This option will auto detect narrow internal solid infill area. If enabled, concentric pattern will be used for the area to speed printing up. Otherwise, rectilinear pattern is used defaultly.
detect_narrow_internal_solid_infill.label: Detect narrow internal solid infill

detect_overhang_wall.description: Detect the overhang percentage relative to line width and use different speed to print. For 100 percent overhang, bridge speed is used.
detect_overhang_wall.label: Detect overhang wall

detect_thin_wall.description: Detect thin wall which can't contain two line width. And use single line to print. Maybe printed not very well, because it's not closed loop
detect_thin_wall.label: Detect thin wall

during_print_exhaust_fan_speed.description: Speed of exhaust fan during printing.This speed will overwrite the speed in filament custom gcode
during_print_exhaust_fan_speed.label: Fan speed

elefant_foot_compensation.description: Shrink the initial layer on build plate to compensate for elephant foot effect
elefant_foot_compensation.label: Elephant foot compensation

embedding_wall_into_infill.description: Embedding the wall into parts where the wall loops are absent ensures that the wall connects seamlessly to the infill.
embedding_wall_into_infill.label: Embedding the wall into the infill

enable_arc_fitting.description: Enable this to get a G-code file which has G2 and G3 moves. And the fitting tolerance is the same as resolution
enable_arc_fitting.label: Arc fitting

enable_circle_compensation.description: Expirment feature to compensate the circle holes and circle contour. This feature is used to improve the accuracy of the circle holes and contour within the diameter below 50mm. Only support PLA Basic, PLA CF, PET CF, PETG CF and PETG HF.
enable_circle_compensation.label: Auto circle contour-hole compensation

enable_filament_dynamic_map.description: Support filament map to different nozzle
enable_filament_dynamic_map.label: Enable filament dynamic map

enable_height_slowdown.description: Enable this option to slow printing down by height
enable_height_slowdown.label: Slow down by height

enable_mixed_color_sublayer.description: Enable mixed color sublayer splitting. When enabled, layers containing mixed color filaments will be split into sub-layers to achieve color mixing effects.
enable_mixed_color_sublayer.label: Mixed color sublayer

enable_order_independent_overlap_carving.description: When enabled, overlapping model parts are carved by bounding-box size so smaller embedded parts are not removed by larger parts due to volume order.
enable_order_independent_overlap_carving.label: Order-independent overlap carving

enable_overhang_bridge_fan.description: Enable this option to optimize part cooling fan speed for overhang and bridge to get better cooling
enable_overhang_bridge_fan.label: Force cooling for overhang and bridge

enable_overhang_speed.description: Enable this option to slow printing down for different overhang degree
enable_overhang_speed.label: Slow down for overhang

enable_pressure_advance.description: Enable pressure advance, auto calibration result will be overwritten once enabled. Useless for Bambu Printer
enable_pressure_advance.label: Enable pressure advance

enable_prime_tower.description: The wiping tower can be used to clean up the residue on the nozzle and stabilize the chamber pressure inside the nozzle, in order to avoid appearance defects when printing objects.
enable_prime_tower.label: Enable

enable_support_ironing.description: Ironing is using small flow to print on same height of surface again to make flat surface more smooth. This setting controls whether support interface or raft interface will be ironned.Support ironing could only works on solid interface,that is, support_interface_spacing was zero and support_interface_pattern was't grid
enable_support_ironing.label: Enable ironing support interface

enable_tower_interface_features.description: When enabled, use dedicated temperature, pre-extrusion and purge settings for prime tower interface layers (where different materials meet), to improve multi-material tool change quality.
enable_tower_interface_features.label: Enable tower interface features

eng_plate_temp.description: Bed temperature for layers except the initial one. Value 0 means the filament does not support to print on the Engineering Plate
eng_plate_temp.label: Other layers

eng_plate_temp_initial_layer.description: Bed temperature of the initial layer. Value 0 means the filament does not support to print on the Engineering Plate
eng_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: Initial layer

ensure_vertical_shell_thickness.description: Add solid infill near sloping surfaces to guarantee the vertical shell thickness (top+bottom solid layers)
ensure_vertical_shell_thickness.label: Ensure vertical shell thickness

exclude_object.description: Enable this option to add EXCLUDE OBJECT command in g-code for klipper firmware printer
exclude_object.label: Exclude objects

extruder.default_expression: none: Studio has no static default; inherit the object's assignment
extruder.label: Extruder

extruder_clearance_dist_to_rod.description: Horizontal distance of the nozzle tip to the rod's farther edge. Used for collision avoidance in by-object printing.
extruder_clearance_dist_to_rod.label: Distance to rod

extruder_clearance_height_to_lid.description: Distance of the nozzle tip to the lid. Used for collision avoidance in by-object printing.
extruder_clearance_height_to_lid.label: Height to lid

extruder_clearance_height_to_rod.description: Distance of the nozzle tip to the lower rod. Used for collision avoidance in by-object printing.
extruder_clearance_height_to_rod.label: Height to rod

extruder_clearance_max_radius.description: Max clearance radius around extruder. Used for collision avoidance in by-object printing.
extruder_clearance_max_radius.label: Max Radius

extruder_colour.description: Only used as a visual help on UI
extruder_colour.label: Extruder Color

extruder_printable_height.description: Maximum printable height of this extruder which is limited by mechanism of printer
extruder_printable_height.label: Extruder printable height

extruder_type.description: This setting is only used for initial value of manual calibration of pressure advance. Bowden extruder usually has larger pa value. This setting doesn't influence normal slicing
extruder_type.label: Type

fan_cooling_layer_time.description: Part cooling fan will be enabled for layers of which estimated time is shorter than this value. Fan speed is interpolated between the minimum and maximum fan speeds according to layer printing time
fan_cooling_layer_time.label: Layer time

fan_direction.description: Cooling fan direction of the printer
fan_direction.label: Fan direction

fan_max_speed.description: Part cooling fan speed may be increased when auto cooling is enabled. This is the maximum speed limitation of part cooling fan
fan_max_speed.label: Fan speed

fan_min_speed.description: Minimum speed for part cooling fan
fan_min_speed.label: Fan speed

farthest_point_timelapse.description: When enabled, the timelapse snapshot is taken at the farthest point from camera instead of traveling to the wipe tower or excess chute. Only effective in instant timelapse mode on non-I3 printers.
farthest_point_timelapse.label: Farthest point timelapse

filament_adaptive_volumetric_speed.description: When enabled, the extrusion flow is limited by the smaller of the fitted value (calculated from line width and layer height) and the user-defined maximum flow. When disabled, only the user-defined maximum flow is applied.
filament_adaptive_volumetric_speed.label: Adaptive volumetric speed

filament_bridge_speed.description: Speed of bridge and completely overhang wall
filament_bridge_speed.label: Bridge

filament_change_length.description: When changing the extruder, it is recommended to extrude a certain length of filament from the original extruder. This helps minimize nozzle oozing.
filament_change_length.label: Extruder change

filament_change_length_nc.description: When changing the hotend, it is recommended to extrude a certain length of filament from the original nozzle. This helps minimize nozzle oozing.
filament_change_length_nc.label: Hotend change

filament_colour.description: Only used as a visual help on UI
filament_colour.label: Color

filament_cooling_before_tower.description: Temperature drop before entering filament tower
filament_cooling_before_tower.label: Wipe tower cooling

filament_deretraction_speed.description: Speed for reloading filament into extruder. Zero means the same speed as retraction
filament_deretraction_speed.label: Deretraction Speed

filament_diameter.description: Filament diameter is used to calculate extrusion in gcode, so it's important and should be accurate
filament_diameter.label: Diameter

filament_enable_overhang_speed.description: Enable this option to slow printing down for different overhang degree
filament_enable_overhang_speed.label: Slow down for overhang

filament_end_gcode.description: End G-code when finish the printing of this filament
filament_end_gcode.label: End G-code

filament_extruder_compatibility.description: A single 32-bit int encoding the compatibility level of a filament across all extruders (up to 10). Every 3 bits represent one extruder (bits [3*i, 3*i+2] for extruder i). 0: printable, 1: error, 2: critical warning, 3: warning, 4-7: reserved
filament_extruder_compatibility.label: Filament-extruder compatibility

filament_flow_ratio.description: The material may have volumetric change after switching between molten state and crystalline state. This setting changes all extrusion flow of this filament in gcode proportionally. Recommended value range is between 0.95 and 1.05. Maybe you can tune this value to get nice flat surface when there has slight overflow or underflow
filament_flow_ratio.label: Flow ratio

filament_flush_temp.description: temperature when flushing filament. 0 indicates the upper bound of the recommended nozzle temperature range
filament_flush_temp.label: Flush temperature

filament_flush_temp_fast.description: Flush temperature used in fast purge mode.
filament_flush_temp_fast.label: Flush temperature

filament_flush_volumetric_speed.description: Volumetric speed when flushing filament. 0 indicates the max volumetric speed
filament_flush_volumetric_speed.label: Flush volumetric speed

filament_is_mixed.description: Whether this filament slot is a mixed filament composed of multiple physical filaments
filament_is_mixed.label: Is mixed filament

filament_is_support.description: Support material is commonly used to print support and support interface
filament_is_support.label: Support material

filament_long_retractions_when_cut.description: Experimental feature.Retracting and cutting off the filament at a longer distance during changes to minimize purge.While this reduces flush significantly, it may also raise the risk of nozzle clogs or other printing problems.
filament_long_retractions_when_cut.label: Long retraction when cut(experimental)

filament_map_2.description: Filament map to the index identified by extruder and nozzle_volume_type
filament_map_2.label: Filament map plus for multi nozzle

filament_map_mode.description: filament mapping mode used as plate param
filament_map_mode.label: filament mapping mode

filament_max_volumetric_speed.description: This setting stands for how much volume of filament can be melted and extruded per second. Printing speed is limited by max volumetric speed, in case of too high and unreasonable speed setting. Can't be zero
filament_max_volumetric_speed.label: Max volumetric speed

filament_metal_stickiness.description: Indicates how strongly the filament tends to stick to the metal nozzle and leave residue. "None" means untested or custom filament, behaves the same as Low. Low: e.g. PLA - retraction can be safely skipped in infill areas. Medium: moderate stickiness - use with caution. High: e.g. PETG - retraction should not be skipped to avoid oozing artifacts on outer walls.
filament_metal_stickiness.label: Metal stickiness

filament_mixed_components.description: Comma-separated 1-based indices of component filaments, e.g. "1,3"
filament_mixed_components.label: Mixed filament components

filament_mixed_gradient.description: Enable Z-direction gradient mode for mixed filament sub-layers. When enabled, the sub-layer ratios vary linearly across layers.
filament_mixed_gradient.label: Mixed filament gradient

filament_mixed_gradient_curve.description: Optional Photoshop-style custom curve mapping Z progress to the first component ratio. Encoded as pipe-separated control points, either "x,y" (legacy) or "x,y,m_in,m_out" when a tangent override is needed (empty token or "nan" means use PCHIP default).
filament_mixed_gradient_curve.label: Mixed filament gradient curve

filament_mixed_gradient_per_part.description: When gradient mode is enabled, apply the gradient to each part of an assembly independently rather than treating the whole assembly as one Z range.
filament_mixed_gradient_per_part.label: Mixed filament per-part gradient

filament_mixed_gradient_range.description: Start and end ratios for the first component in gradient mode. Comma-separated pair, e.g. "0.10,0.90" means 10% to 90%.
filament_mixed_gradient_range.label: Mixed filament gradient range

filament_mixed_sublayer_ratios.description: Comma-separated ratio values summing to 1.0, e.g. "0.7,0.3"
filament_mixed_sublayer_ratios.label: Mixed filament sublayer ratios

filament_notes.description: You can put your notes regarding the filament here.
filament_notes.label: Filament notes

filament_overhang_totally_speed.description: Speed of 100% overhang wall which has 0 overlap with the lower layer.

filament_pre_cooling_temperature.description: To prevent oozing, the nozzle temperature will be cooled during ramming. Therefore, the ramming time must be greater than the cooldown time. 0 means disabled.
filament_pre_cooling_temperature.label: Extruder change

filament_pre_cooling_temperature_nc.description: To prevent oozing, the nozzle temperature will be cooled during ramming. Note: only a cooldown command and fan activation are triggered, reaching the target temperature is not guaranteed. 0 means disabled.
filament_pre_cooling_temperature_nc.label: Hotend change

filament_preheat_temperature_delta.description: Temperature delta applied during pre-heating before tool change.
filament_preheat_temperature_delta.label: Preheat temperature delta

filament_prime_volume.description: The volume of material required to prime the extruder on the tower, excluding a hotend change.
filament_prime_volume.label: Filament change

filament_prime_volume_nc.description: The volume of material required to prime the extruder for a hotend change on the tower.
filament_prime_volume_nc.label: Hotend change

filament_printable.description: The filament is printable in extruder
filament_printable.label: Filament printable

filament_ramming_travel_time.description: To prevent oozing, the nozzle will perform a reverse travel movement for a certain period after the ramming is complete. The setting define the travel time.
filament_ramming_travel_time.label: Extruder change

filament_ramming_travel_time_nc.description: To prevent oozing, the nozzle will perform a reverse travel movement for a certain period after the ramming is complete. The setting define the travel time.
filament_ramming_travel_time_nc.label: Hotend change

filament_ramming_volumetric_speed.description: The maximum volumetric speed for ramming before extruder change, where -1 means using the maximum volumetric speed.
filament_ramming_volumetric_speed.label: Extruder change

filament_ramming_volumetric_speed_nc.description: The maximum volumetric speed for ramming before a hotend change, where -1 means using the maximum volumetric speed.
filament_ramming_volumetric_speed_nc.label: Hotend change

filament_retract_before_wipe.description: The length of fast retraction before wipe, relative to retraction length
filament_retract_before_wipe.label: Retract amount before wipe

filament_retract_length_nc.description: When this retraction value is modified, it will be used as the amount of filament retracted inside the hotend before changing hotends.
filament_retract_length_nc.label: length when change hotend

filament_retract_lift_above.description: Z hop will only come into effect when Z is above this value and is below the parameter: "Z hop upper boundary"
filament_retract_lift_above.label: Z hop lower boundary

filament_retract_lift_below.description: If this value is positive, Z hop will only come into effect when Z is above the parameter: "Z hop lower boundary" and is below this value
filament_retract_lift_below.label: Z hop upper boundary

filament_retract_restart_extra.description: When the retraction is compensated after the travel move, the extruder will push this additional amount of filament. This setting is rarely needed.
filament_retract_restart_extra.label: Extra length on restart

filament_retract_when_changing_layer.description: Force a retraction when changes layer
filament_retract_when_changing_layer.label: Retract when change layer

filament_retraction_distances_when_cut.description: Experimental feature.Retraction length before cutting off during filament change
filament_retraction_distances_when_cut.label: Retraction distance when cut

filament_retraction_length.description: Some amount of material in extruder is pulled back to avoid ooze during long travel. Set zero to disable retraction
filament_retraction_length.label: Length

filament_retraction_minimum_travel.description: Only trigger retraction when the travel distance is longer than this threshold
filament_retraction_minimum_travel.label: Travel distance threshold

filament_scarf_gap.description: In order to reduce the visiblity of the seam in closed loop, the inner wall and outer wall are shortened by a specified amount.
filament_scarf_gap.label: Scarf slope gap

filament_scarf_height.description: This amount can be specified in millimeters or as a percentage of the current layer height.
filament_scarf_height.label: Scarf start height

filament_scarf_length.description: Length of the scarf. Setting this parameter to zero effectively disables the scarf.
filament_scarf_length.label: Scarf length

filament_scarf_seam_type.description: Set scarf seam type for this filament. This setting could minimize seam visibiliy.
filament_scarf_seam_type.label: Scarf seam type

filament_shrink.description:
Enter the shrinkage percentage that the filament will get after cooling (94% if you measure 94mm instead of 100mm). The part will be scaled in xy to compensate. Only the filament used for the perimeter is taken into account.
Be sure to allow enough space between objects, as this compensation is done after the checks.
filament_shrink.label: Shrinkage

filament_soluble.description: Soluble material is commonly used to print support and support interface
filament_soluble.label: Soluble material

filament_start_gcode.description: Start G-code when start the printing of this filament
filament_start_gcode.label: Start G-code

filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_d.description: Pre-extrusion distance for prime tower interface layer (where different materials meet).
filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_d.label: Interface layer pre-extrusion distance

filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_l.description: Pre-extrusion length for prime tower interface layer (where different materials meet).
filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_l.label: Interface layer pre-extrusion length

filament_tower_interface_print_temp.description: Print temperature for prime tower interface layer (where different materials meet). If set to -1, use max recommended nozzle temperature.
filament_tower_interface_print_temp.label: Interface layer print temperature

filament_tower_interface_purge_volume.description: Purge length for prime tower interface layer (where different materials meet).
filament_tower_interface_purge_volume.label: Interface layer purge length

filament_tower_ironing_area.description: Ironing area for prime tower interface layer (where different materials meet).
filament_tower_ironing_area.label: Tower ironing area

filament_velocity_adaptation_factor.description: This parameter reflects the speed at which a material transitions from one state to another. It, along with the smooth coefficient, determines the final length of the transition zone. A larger value: requires a shorter transition zone. A smaller value: requires a longer transition zone to avoid flow instability.
filament_velocity_adaptation_factor.label: Velocity Adaptation Factor

filament_vendor.description: Vendor of filament. For show only
filament_vendor.label: Vendor

filament_wipe.description: Move nozzle along the last extrusion path when retracting to clean leaked material on nozzle. This can minimize blob when printing new part after travel
filament_wipe.label: Wipe while retracting

filament_wipe_distance.description: Describe how long the nozzle will move along the last path when retracting
filament_wipe_distance.label: Wipe Distance

filament_z_hop.description: Whenever the retraction is done, the nozzle is lifted a little to create clearance between nozzle and the print. It prevents nozzle from hitting the print when travel moves. Using spiral line to lift z can prevent stringing
filament_z_hop.label: Z hop when retract

filename_format.description: User can self-define the project file name when export
filename_format.label: Filename format

fill_multiline.description: Using multiple lines for the infill pattern, if supported by infill pattern.
fill_multiline.label: Fill multiline

filter_out_gap_fill.description: Filter out gaps smaller than the threshold specified. Gaps smaller than this threshold will be ignored
filter_out_gap_fill.label: Filter out tiny gaps

first_x_layer_fan_speed.description: Special auxiliary cooling fan speed, effective only for the first x layers
first_x_layer_fan_speed.label: Fan speed

first_x_layer_part_fan_speed.description: Part cooling fan speed for the first few layers. Set to 0 to disable the part cooling fan on the initial layers for better bed adhesion
first_x_layer_part_fan_speed.label: Fan speed

flush_into_infill.description: Purging after filament change will be done inside objects' infills. This may lower the amount of waste and decrease the print time. If the walls are printed with transparent filament, the mixed color infill will be seen outside. It will not take effect, unless the prime tower is enabled.
flush_into_infill.label: Flush into objects' infill

flush_into_objects.description: This object will be used to purge the nozzle after a filament change to save filament and decrease the print time. Colours of the objects will be mixed as a result. It will not take effect, unless the prime tower is enabled.
flush_into_objects.label: Flush into this object

flush_into_support.description: Purging after filament change will be done inside objects' support. This may lower the amount of waste and decrease the print time. It will not take effect, unless the prime tower is enabled.
flush_into_support.label: Flush into objects' support

flush_multiplier.description: The actual flushing volumes is equal to the flush multiplier multiplied by the flushing volumes in the table.
flush_multiplier.label: Flush multiplier

flush_multiplier_fast.description: The flush multiplier used in fast purge mode.
flush_multiplier_fast.label: Flush multiplier (Fast mode)

fuzzy_skin.description: Randomly jitter while printing the wall, so that the surface has a rough look. This setting controls the fuzzy position
fuzzy_skin.label: Fuzzy Skin

fuzzy_skin_first_layer.description: Whether to apply fuzzy skin on the first layer.
fuzzy_skin_first_layer.label: Apply fuzzy skin to first layer

fuzzy_skin_mode.description:
Displacement: Pattern is formed by shifting the nozzle sideways from the original path.
Extrusion: Pattern is formed by varying the amount of extruded plastic (nozzle path stays straight).
Combined: Displacement + Extrusion. Similar look to Displacement but fills gaps between perimeters.
Note: Extrusion and Combined only work when fuzzy skin thickness is not greater than the printed line width.
fuzzy_skin_mode.label: Fuzzy skin generator mode

fuzzy_skin_noise_type.description:
Noise type to use for fuzzy skin generation:
Classic: Classic uniform random noise.
Perlin: Perlin noise, which gives a more consistent texture.
Billow: Similar to perlin noise, but clumpier.
Ridged Multifractal: Ridged noise with sharp, jagged features. Creates marble-like textures.
Voronoi: Divides the surface into voronoi cells, and displaces each one by a random amount. Creates a patchwork texture.
fuzzy_skin_noise_type.label: Fuzzy skin noise type

fuzzy_skin_octaves.description: The number of octaves of coherent noise to use. Higher values increase the detail of the noise, but also increase computation time.
fuzzy_skin_octaves.label: Fuzzy skin noise octaves

fuzzy_skin_persistence.description: The decay rate for higher octaves of the coherent noise. Lower values will result in smoother noise.
fuzzy_skin_persistence.label: Fuzzy skin noise persistence

fuzzy_skin_point_distance.description: The average distance between the random points introduced on each line segment
fuzzy_skin_point_distance.label: Fuzzy skin point distance

fuzzy_skin_scale.description: The base size of the coherent noise features, in mm. Higher values will result in larger features.
fuzzy_skin_scale.label: Fuzzy skin feature size

fuzzy_skin_thickness.description: The width within which to jitter. It's adversed to be below outer wall line width
fuzzy_skin_thickness.label: Fuzzy skin thickness

gap_infill_speed.description: Speed of gap infill. Gap usually has irregular line width and should be printed more slowly
gap_infill_speed.label: Gap infill

gcode_add_line_number.description: Enable this to add line number(Nx) at the beginning of each G-Code line
gcode_add_line_number.label: Add line number

gcode_flavor.description: What kind of gcode the printer is compatible with
gcode_flavor.label: G-code flavor

has_filament_switcher.description: Whether a filament switcher is connected to the printer
has_filament_switcher.label: Has filament switcher

host_type.description: Slic3r can upload G-code files to a printer host. This field must contain the kind of the host.
host_type.excluded_reason: printer communication is outside this server's scope
host_type.label: Host Type

hot_plate_temp.description: Bed temperature for layers except the initial one. Value 0 means the filament does not support to print on the High Temp Plate
hot_plate_temp.label: Other layers

hot_plate_temp_initial_layer.description: Bed temperature of the initial layer. Value 0 means the filament does not support to print on the High Temp Plate
hot_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: Initial layer

independent_support_layer_height.description: Support layer uses layer height independent with object layer. This is to support customizing z-gap and save print time.This option will be invalid when the prime tower is enabled.
independent_support_layer_height.label: Independent support layer height

infill_combination.description: Automatically Combine sparse infill of several layers to print together to reduce time. Wall is still printed with original layer height.
infill_combination.label: Infill combination

infill_direction.description: Angle for sparse infill pattern, which controls the start or main direction of line
infill_direction.label: Infill direction

infill_instead_top_bottom_surfaces.description: Using infill instead of top and bottom surfaces.
infill_instead_top_bottom_surfaces.label: Use infill instead of top and bottom surfaces

infill_lock_depth.description: The parameter sets the overlapping depth between the interior and skin.
infill_lock_depth.label: Infill lock depth

infill_rotate_step.description: This parameter adds a slight rotation to each layer of infill to create a cross texture.
infill_rotate_step.label: Infill rotate step

infill_shift_step.description: This parameter adds a slight displacement to each layer of infill to create a cross texture.
infill_shift_step.label: Infill shift step

infill_wall_overlap.description: Infill area is enlarged slightly to overlap with wall for better bonding. The percentage value is relative to line width of sparse infill
infill_wall_overlap.label: Infill/Wall overlap

initial_layer_acceleration.description: Acceleration of initial layer. Using a lower value can improve build plate adhensive
initial_layer_acceleration.label: Initial layer

initial_layer_flow_ratio.description: This factor affects the amount of material for the initial layer
initial_layer_flow_ratio.label: Initial layer flow ratio

initial_layer_infill_line_width.description: Line width of the infill of initial layer, including sparse infill, solid infill and top surface. Walls, support and everything else of the initial layer are not affected and keep using the line width of initial layer. Zero means to use the line width of initial layer.
initial_layer_infill_line_width.label: Initial layer infill

initial_layer_infill_speed.description: Speed of solid infill part of initial layer
initial_layer_infill_speed.label: Initial layer infill

initial_layer_print_height.description: Height of initial layer. Making initial layer height thick slightly can improve build plate adhension
initial_layer_print_height.label: Initial layer height

initial_layer_speed.description: Speed of initial layer except the solid infill part
initial_layer_speed.label: Initial layer

initial_layer_travel_acceleration.description: The acceleration of travel of initial layer
initial_layer_travel_acceleration.label: Initial layer travel

inner_wall_acceleration.description: Acceleration of inner walls. 0 means using normal printing acceleration
inner_wall_acceleration.label: Inner wall

interface_shells.description: Force the generation of solid shells between adjacent materials/volumes. Useful for multi-extruder prints with translucent materials or manual soluble support material
interface_shells.label: Interface shells

interlocking_beam.description: Generate interlocking beam structure at the locations where different filaments touch. This improves the adhesion between filaments, especially models printed in different materials.
interlocking_beam.label: Use beam interlocking

interlocking_beam_layer_count.description: The height of the beams of the interlocking structure, measured in number of layers. Less layers is stronger, but more prone to defects.
interlocking_beam_layer_count.label: Interlocking beam layers

interlocking_beam_width.description: The width of the interlocking structure beams.
interlocking_beam_width.label: Interlocking beam width

interlocking_boundary_avoidance.description: The distance from the outside of a model where interlocking structures will not be generated, measured in cells.
interlocking_boundary_avoidance.label: Interlocking boundary avoidance

interlocking_depth.description: The distance from the boundary between filaments to generate interlocking structure, measured in cells. Too few cells will result in poor adhesion.
interlocking_depth.label: Interlocking depth

internal_bridge_support_thickness.description: When sparse infill density is low, the internal solid infill or internal bridge may have no archor at the end of line. This causes falling and bad quality when printing internal solid infill. When enable this feature, loop paths will be added to the sparse fill of the lower layers for specific thickness, so that better archor can be provided for internal bridge. 0 means disable this feature
internal_bridge_support_thickness.label: Internal bridge support thickness

internal_solid_infill_line_width.description: Line width of internal solid infill
internal_solid_infill_line_width.label: Internal solid infill

internal_solid_infill_pattern.description: Line pattern of internal solid infill. if the detect narrow internal solid infill be enabled, the concentric pattern will be used for the small area.
internal_solid_infill_pattern.label: Internal solid infill pattern

internal_solid_infill_speed.description: Speed of internal solid infill, not the top and bottom surface
internal_solid_infill_speed.label: Internal solid infill

ironing_direction.description: Angle for ironing, which controls the relative angle between the top surface and ironing
ironing_direction.label: ironing direction

ironing_fan_speed.description: This part cooling fan speed is applied when ironing. Setting this parameter to a lower than regular speed reduces possible nozzle clogging due to the low volumetric flow rate, making the interface smoother. Set to -1 to disable it.
ironing_fan_speed.label: Ironing fan speed

ironing_flow.description: The amount of material to extrude during ironing. Relative to flow of normal layer height. Too high value results in overextrusion on the surface
ironing_flow.label: Ironing flow

ironing_inset.description: The distance to keep the from the edges of ironing line. 0 means not apply.
ironing_inset.label: Ironing inset

ironing_spacing.description: The distance between the lines of ironing
ironing_spacing.label: Ironing line spacing

ironing_type.description: Ironing is using small flow to print on same height of surface again to make flat surface more smooth. This setting controls which layer being ironed
ironing_type.label: Ironing Type

is_infill_first.description: Order of wall/infill. false means print wall first.
is_infill_first.label: Print infill first

layer_change_gcode.description: This gcode part is inserted at every layer change after lift z
layer_change_gcode.label: Layer change G-code

layer_height.description: Slicing height for each layer. Smaller layer height means more accurate and more printing time
layer_height.label: Layer height

line_width.description: Default line width if some line width is set to be zero
line_width.label: Default

long_retractions_when_cut.description: Experimental feature.Retracting and cutting off the filament at a longer distance during changes to minimize purge.While this reduces flush significantly, it may also raise the risk of nozzle clogs or other printing problems.
long_retractions_when_cut.label: Long retraction when cut(experimental)

machine_bed_mass_Y.description: The machine bed mass load of Y axis
machine_bed_mass_Y.label: machine_bed_mass_Y

machine_end_gcode.default:
M104 S0 ; turn off temperature
G28 X0  ; home X axis
M84     ; disable motors
machine_end_gcode.description: End G-code when finish the whole printing
machine_end_gcode.label: End G-code

machine_load_filament_time.description: Time to load new filament when switch filament. For statistics only
machine_load_filament_time.label: Filament load time

machine_max_force_Y.description: The allowed maximum output force of Y axis
machine_max_force_Y.label: machine_max_force_Y

machine_max_printed_mass.description: The allowed max printed mass on a plate
machine_max_printed_mass.label: machine_max_printed_mass

machine_pause_gcode.description: This G-code will be used as a code for the pause print. User can insert pause G-code in gcode viewer
machine_pause_gcode.label: Pause G-code

machine_start_gcode.default:
G28 ; home all axes
G1 Z5 F5000 ; lift nozzle
machine_start_gcode.description: Start G-code when start the whole printing
machine_start_gcode.label: Start G-code

machine_switch_extruder_time.description: Time to switch extruder. For statistics only
machine_switch_extruder_time.label: Extruder switch time

machine_unload_filament_time.description: Time to unload old filament when switch filament. For statistics only
machine_unload_filament_time.label: Filament unload time

master_extruder_id.description: Default extruder id to place filament
master_extruder_id.label: Master extruder id

max_bridge_length.description: Max length of bridges that don't need support. Set it to 0 if you want all bridges to be supported, and set it to a very large value if you don't want any bridges to be supported.
max_bridge_length.label: Max bridge length

max_layer_height.description: The largest printable layer height for extruder. Used to limit the maximum layer height when enable adaptive layer height
max_layer_height.label: Max

max_travel_detour_distance.description: Maximum detour distance for avoiding crossing wall. Don't detour if the detour distance is larger than this value. Detour length could be specified either as an absolute value or as percentage (for example 50%) of a direct travel path. Zero to disable
max_travel_detour_distance.label: Avoid crossing wall - Max detour length

min_bead_width.description: Width of the wall that will replace thin features (according to the Minimum feature size) of the model. If the Minimum wall width is thinner than the thickness of the feature, the wall will become as thick as the feature itself. It's expressed as a percentage over nozzle diameter
min_bead_width.label: Minimum wall width

min_feature_size.description: Minimum thickness of thin features. Model features that are thinner than this value will not be printed, while features thicker than the Minimum feature size will be widened to the Minimum wall width. It's expressed as a percentage over nozzle diameter
min_feature_size.label: Minimum feature size

min_layer_height.description: The lowest printable layer height for extruder. Used to limit the minimum layer height when enable adaptive layer height
min_layer_height.label: Min

minimum_sparse_infill_area.description: Sparse infill area which is smaller than threshold value is replaced by internal solid infill
minimum_sparse_infill_area.label: Minimum sparse infill threshold

mmu_segmented_region_interlocking_depth.description: Interlocking depth of a segmented region. Zero disables this feature.
mmu_segmented_region_interlocking_depth.label: Interlocking depth of a segmented region

mmu_segmented_region_max_width.description: Maximum width of a segmented region. Zero disables this feature.
mmu_segmented_region_max_width.label: Maximum width of a segmented region

modifier_ignore_infill.description: Do not apply this modifier's infill settings (pattern, density, conformal infill, and related options). Walls and other overrides still apply. Infill is taken from the parent region.
modifier_ignore_infill.label: Ignore infill settings

monotonic_travel_into_wall.description: Enable this option to extend the travel distance between lines, improving the adhesion between the monotonic line infill and the walls.(percent to line width)
monotonic_travel_into_wall.label: Monotonic line travel extend

no_slow_down_for_cooling_on_outwalls.description:
If enabled, this setting will ensure external perimeters are not slowed down to meet the minimum layer time. This is particularly helpful in the below scenarios:
1. To avoid changes in shine when printing glossy filaments
2. To avoid changes in external wall speed which may create slight wall artifacts that appear like Z banding
3. To avoid printing at speeds which cause VFAs (fine artifacts) on the external walls
no_slow_down_for_cooling_on_outwalls.label: Don't slow down outer walls

nozzle_temperature.description: Nozzle temperature for layers after the initial one
nozzle_temperature.label: Other layers

nozzle_temperature_initial_layer.description: Nozzle temperature to print initial layer when using this filament
nozzle_temperature_initial_layer.label: Initial layer

nozzle_volume.description: Volume of nozzle between the cutter and the end of nozzle
nozzle_volume.label: Nozzle volume

only_one_wall_first_layer.description: Use only one wall on the first layer of model
only_one_wall_first_layer.label: Only one wall on first layer

other_layers_print_sequence_nums.label: The number of other layers print sequence

outer_wall_acceleration.description: Acceleration of outer wall. Using a lower value can improve quality
outer_wall_acceleration.label: Outer wall

outer_wall_speed.description: Speed of outer wall which is outermost and visible. It's used to be slower than inner wall speed to get better quality.
outer_wall_speed.label: Outer wall

overhang_fan_speed.description: Force part cooling fan to be at this speed when printing bridge or overhang wall which has large overhang degree. Forcing cooling for overhang and bridge can get better quality for these part
overhang_fan_speed.label: Fan speed for overhang

overhang_fan_threshold.description: Force cooling fan to be specific speed when overhang degree of printed part exceeds this value. Expressed as percentage which indicides how much width of the line without support from lower layer. 0% means forcing cooling for all outer wall no matter how much overhang degree
overhang_fan_threshold.label: Cooling overhang threshold

overhang_threshold_participating_cooling.description: Decide which overhang part join the cooling function to slow down the speed.Expressed as percentage which indicides how much width of the line without support from lower layer. 100% means forcing cooling for all outer wall no matter how much overhang degree
overhang_threshold_participating_cooling.label: Overhang threshold for participating cooling

overhang_totally_speed.description: Speed of 100% overhang wall which has 0 overlap with the lower layer.

override_filament_scarf_seam_setting.description: Overrider filament scarf seam setting and could control settings by modifier.
override_filament_scarf_seam_setting.label: Override filament scarf seam setting

override_process_overhang_speed.description: Override the overhang speed in process page
override_process_overhang_speed.label: Override overhang speed

periodic_modifier.description: Apply this modifier on a repeating layer cycle. On skipped layers it is ignored, as if this modifier were not there.
periodic_modifier.label: Periodic modifier

periodic_modifier_apply_layers.description: Number of consecutive layers in each cycle on which this modifier is fully applied. The cycle starts at layer 0: first Apply for, then Skip for.
periodic_modifier_apply_layers.label: Apply for

periodic_modifier_skip_layers.description: Number of consecutive layers on which this modifier is not applied. 0 means the modifier is applied on every layer.
periodic_modifier_skip_layers.label: Skip for

physical_extruder_map.description: Map the logical extruder to physical extruder
physical_extruder_map.label: Map the logical extruder to physical extruder

post_process.description: If you want to process the output G-code through custom scripts, just list their absolute paths here. Separate multiple scripts with a semicolon. Scripts will be passed the absolute path to the G-code file as the first argument, and variables of settings also can be read
post_process.label: Post-processing Scripts

pre_start_fan_time.description: Force fan start early(0-5 second) when encountering overhangs. This is because the fan needs time to physically increase its speed.
pre_start_fan_time.label: Pre start fan time

precise_outer_wall.description: Improve shell precision by adjusting outer wall spacing. This also improves layer consistency.
precise_outer_wall.label: Precise wall

precise_z_height.description: Enable this to get precise z height of object after slicing. It will get the precise object height by fine-tuning the layer heights of the last few layers. Note that this is an experimental parameter.
precise_z_height.label: Precise Z height

preset_name.label: preset_name

pressure_advance.description: Pressure advance(Klipper) AKA Linear advance factor(Marlin). Useless for Bambu Printer
pressure_advance.label: Pressure advance

prime_tower_brim_width.description: Brim width of prime tower, negative number means auto calculated width based on the height of prime tower.
prime_tower_brim_width.label: Brim width

prime_tower_enable_framework.description: Enable internal ribs to increase the stability of the prime tower.
prime_tower_enable_framework.label: Internal ribs

prime_tower_extra_rib_length.description: Positive values can increase the size of the rib wall, while negative values can reduce the size.However, the size of the rib wall can not be smaller than that determined by the cleaning volume.
prime_tower_extra_rib_length.label: Extra rib length

prime_tower_fillet_wall.description: The wall of prime tower will fillet
prime_tower_fillet_wall.label: Fillet wall

prime_tower_max_speed.description: The maximum printing speed on the prime tower excluding ramming.
prime_tower_max_speed.label: Max speed

prime_tower_rib_wall.description: The wall of prime tower will add four ribs and make its cross-section as close to a square as possible, so the width will be fixed.
prime_tower_rib_wall.label: Rib wall

prime_tower_rib_width.description: Rib width is always less than half the prime tower side length.
prime_tower_rib_width.label: Rib width

prime_tower_skip_points.description: The wall of prime tower will skip the start points of wipe path
prime_tower_skip_points.label: Skip points

print_flow_ratio.description: The flow ratio set by object, the meaning is the same as flow ratio.
print_flow_ratio.label: Object flow ratio

print_in_clockwise.label: Print loops in clockwise

print_sequence.description: Print sequence, layer by layer or object by object
print_sequence.label: Print sequence

printable_height.description: Maximum printable height which is limited by mechanism of printer
printable_height.label: Printable height

printer_notes.description: You can put your notes regarding the printer here.
printer_notes.label: Printer notes

printer_structure.description: The physical arrangement and components of a printing device
