printing_by_object_gcode.description: Insert Gcode between objects. This parameter will only come into effect when you print your models object by object
printing_by_object_gcode.label: Between Object Gcode

process_notes.description: You can put your notes regarding the process here.
process_notes.label: Process notes

raft_contact_distance.description: Z gap between object and raft. Ignored for soluble interface
raft_contact_distance.label: Raft contact Z distance

raft_expansion.description: Expand all raft layers in XY plane
raft_expansion.label: Raft expansion

raft_first_layer_density.description: Density of the first raft or support layer
raft_first_layer_density.label: Initial layer density

raft_first_layer_expansion.description: Expand the first raft or support layer to improve bed plate adhesion, -1 means auto
raft_first_layer_expansion.label: Initial layer expansion

raft_layers.description: Object will be raised by this number of support layers. Use this function to avoid warping when print ABS
raft_layers.label: Raft layers

reduce_crossing_wall.description: Detour and avoid traveling across wall which may cause blob on surface (when travel length greater than Travel distance threshold)
reduce_crossing_wall.label: Avoid crossing wall

reduce_fan_stop_start_freq.description: If enable this setting, part cooling fan will never be stopped and will run at least at minimum speed to reduce the frequency of starting and stopping
reduce_fan_stop_start_freq.label: Keep fan always on

reduce_infill_retraction_mode.description: Controls whether retraction is skipped when traveling within the infill area. "Auto" enables this optimization for filaments with low metal stickiness (e.g. PLA) and disables it for medium/high metal stickiness filaments (e.g. PETG) to avoid oozing artifacts. "Enabled" always skips retraction in infill areas regardless of filament type. "Disabled" always retracts normally.
reduce_infill_retraction_mode.label: Reduce infill retraction

required_nozzle_HRC.description: Minimum HRC of nozzle required to print the filament. Zero means no checking of nozzle's HRC.
required_nozzle_HRC.label: Required nozzle HRC

resolution.description: G-code path is generated after simplifying the contour of model to avoid too many points and gcode lines in the gcode file. Smaller value means higher resolution and more time to slice
resolution.label: Resolution

retract_before_wipe.description: The length of fast retraction before wipe, relative to retraction length
retract_before_wipe.label: Retract amount before wipe

retract_lift_above.description: Z hop will only come into effect when Z is above this value and is below the parameter: "Z hop upper boundary"
retract_lift_above.label: Z hop lower boundary

retract_lift_below.description: If this value is positive, Z hop will only come into effect when Z is above the parameter: "Z hop lower boundary" and is below this value
retract_lift_below.label: Z hop upper boundary

retract_restart_extra.description: When the retraction is compensated after the travel move, the extruder will push this additional amount of filament. This setting is rarely needed.
retract_restart_extra.label: Extra length on restart

retract_restart_extra_toolchange.description: When the retraction is compensated after changing tool, the extruder will push this additional amount of filament.
retract_restart_extra_toolchange.label: Extra length on restart

retract_when_changing_layer.description: Force a retraction when changes layer
retract_when_changing_layer.label: Retract when change layer

retraction_distances_when_cut.description: Experimental feature.Retraction length before cutting off during filament change
retraction_distances_when_cut.label: Retraction distance when cut

retraction_length.description: Some amount of material in extruder is pulled back to avoid ooze during long travel. Set zero to disable retraction
retraction_length.label: Length

retraction_minimum_travel.description: Only trigger retraction when the travel distance is longer than this threshold
retraction_minimum_travel.label: Travel distance threshold

role_base_wipe_speed.description: The wipe speed is determined by speed of current extrusion role. e.g if a wipe action is executed immediately following an outer wall extrusion, the speed of the outer wall extrusion will be utilized for the wipe action.
role_base_wipe_speed.label: Role-based wipe speed

scan_first_layer.description: Enable this to enable the camera on printer to check the quality of first layer
scan_first_layer.label: Scan first layer

scarf_angle_threshold.description:
This option sets the threshold angle for applying a conditional scarf joint seam.
If the seam angle within the perimeter loop exceeds this value (indicating the absence of sharp corners), a scarf joint seam will be used. The default value is 155°.
scarf_angle_threshold.label: Scarf application angle threshold

seam_gap.description:
In order to reduce the visibility of the seam in a closed loop extrusion, the loop is interrupted and shortened by a specified amount.
This amount as a percentage of the current extruder diameter. The default value for this parameter is 15
seam_gap.label: Seam gap

seam_placement_away_from_overhangs.description: Ensure seam placement away from overhangs for alignment and backing modes.
seam_placement_away_from_overhangs.label: Seam placement away from overhangs(experimental)

seam_position.description: The start position to print each part of outer wall
seam_position.label: Seam position

seam_slope_conditional.description: Apply scarf joints only to smooth perimeters where traditional seams do not conceal the seams at sharp corners effectively.
seam_slope_conditional.label: Smart scarf seam application

seam_slope_entire_loop.description: The scarf extends to the entire length of the wall.
seam_slope_entire_loop.label: Scarf around entire wall

seam_slope_gap.description: In order to reduce the visiblity of the seam in closed loop, the inner wall and outer wall are shortened by a specified amount.
seam_slope_gap.label: Scarf slope gap

seam_slope_inner_walls.description: Use scarf joint for inner walls as well.
seam_slope_inner_walls.label: Scarf joint for inner walls

seam_slope_min_length.description: Length of the scarf. Setting this parameter to zero effectively disables the scarf.
seam_slope_min_length.label: Scarf length

seam_slope_start_height.description: This amount can be specified in millimeters or as a percentage of the current layer height.
seam_slope_start_height.label: Scarf start height

seam_slope_steps.description: Minimum number of segments of each scarf.
seam_slope_steps.label: Scarf steps

seam_slope_type.description: Set scarf seam type for this filament. This setting could minimize seam visibiliy.
seam_slope_type.label: Scarf seam type

silent_mode.description: Whether the machine supports silent mode in which machine use lower acceleration to print
silent_mode.label: Supports silent mode

skeleton_infill_density.description: The remaining part of the model contour after removing a certain depth from the surface is called the skeleton. This parameter is used to adjust the density of this section.When two regions have the same sparse infill settings but different skeleton densities, their skeleton areas will develop overlapping sections.default is as same as infill density.
skeleton_infill_density.label: Skeleton infill density

skeleton_infill_line_width.description: Adjust the line width of the selected skeleton paths.
skeleton_infill_line_width.label: Skeleton line width

skin_infill_density.description: The portion of the model's outer surface within a certain depth range is called the skin. This parameter is used to adjust the density of this section.When two regions have the same sparse infill settings but different skin densities, This area will not be split into two separate regions.default is as same as infill density.
skin_infill_density.label: Skin infill density

skin_infill_depth.description: The parameter sets the depth of skin.
skin_infill_depth.label: Skin infill depth

skin_infill_line_width.description: Adjust the line width of the selected skin paths.
skin_infill_line_width.label: Skin line width

skirt_distance.description: Distance from skirt to brim or object
skirt_distance.label: Skirt distance

skirt_height.description: How many layers of skirt. Usually only one layer
skirt_height.label: Skirt height

skirt_loops.description: Number of loops for the skirt. Zero means disabling skirt
skirt_loops.label: Skirt loops

skirt_per_object.description: Generate independent skirt around each object in sequential printing mode. When disabled, a single skirt is drawn around all objects.
skirt_per_object.label: Skirt per object

slice_closing_radius.description: Cracks smaller than 2x gap closing radius are being filled during the triangle mesh slicing. The gap closing operation may reduce the final print resolution, therefore it is advisable to keep the value reasonably low.
slice_closing_radius.label: Slice gap closing radius

slicing_mode.description: Use "Even-odd" for 3DLabPrint airplane models. Use "Close holes" to close all holes in the model.
slicing_mode.label: Slicing Mode

slow_down_for_layer_cooling.description: Enable this option to slow printing speed down to make the final layer time not shorter than the layer time threshold in "Max fan speed threshold", so that layer can be cooled for a longer time. This can improve the cooling quality for needle and small details
slow_down_for_layer_cooling.label: Slow printing down for better layer cooling

slow_down_layer_time.description: The printing speed in exported gcode will be slowed down, when the estimated layer time is shorter than this value, to get better cooling for these layers
slow_down_layer_time.label: Layer time

slow_down_min_speed.description: The minimum printing speed when slow down for cooling
slow_down_min_speed.label: Min print speed

slowdown_end_height.description: The height finishes slowing down, Ending height should be larger than Starting height, or the slowing down will not work!
slowdown_end_height.label: Ending height

slowdown_start_height.description: The height starts to slow down
slowdown_start_height.label: Starting height

small_perimeter_speed.description: This setting will affect the speed of perimeters having radius <= small perimeter threshold(usually holes). If expressed as percentage (for example: 80%) it will be calculated onthe outer wall speed setting above. Set to zero for auto.
small_perimeter_speed.label: Small perimeters

small_perimeter_threshold.description: This sets the threshold for small perimeter length. Default threshold is 0mm
small_perimeter_threshold.label: Small perimeter threshold

smooth_coefficient.description: The smaller the number, the longer the speed transition path. 0 means not apply.
smooth_coefficient.label: Smooth coefficient

smooth_speed_discontinuity_area.description: Add the speed transition between discontinuity area.
smooth_speed_discontinuity_area.label: Smooth speed discontinuity area

sparse_infill_acceleration.description: Acceleration of sparse infill. If the value is expressed as a percentage (e.g. 100%), it will be calculated based on the default acceleration.
sparse_infill_acceleration.label: Sparse infill

sparse_infill_anchor.description: Connect a sparse infill line to an internal perimeter with a short segment of an additional perimeter. If expressed as percentage (example: 15%) it is calculated over sparse infill line width. Slicer tries to connect two close infill lines to a short perimeter segment. If no such perimeter segment shorter than infill_anchor_max is found, the infill line is connected to a perimeter segment at just one side and the length of the perimeter segment taken is limited to this parameter, but no longer than anchor_length_max. Set this parameter to zero to disable anchoring perimeters connected to a single infill line.
sparse_infill_anchor.label: Length of sparse infill anchor

sparse_infill_anchor_max.description: Connect a sparse infill line to an internal perimeter with a short segment of an additional perimeter. If expressed as percentage (example: 15%) it is calculated over sparse infill line width. Slicer tries to connect two close infill lines to a short perimeter segment. If no such perimeter segment shorter than this parameter is found, the infill line is connected to a perimeter segment at just one side and the length of the perimeter segment taken is limited to infill_anchor, but no longer than this parameter. Set this parameter to zero to disable anchoring.
sparse_infill_anchor_max.label: Maximum length of sparse infill anchor

sparse_infill_density.description: Density of internal sparse infill, 100% means solid throughout
sparse_infill_density.label: Sparse infill density

sparse_infill_filament.description: Filament to print internal sparse infill.
sparse_infill_filament.label: Sparse infill filament

sparse_infill_lattice_angle_1.description: The angle of the first set of 2D lattice elements in the Z direction. Zero is vertical.
sparse_infill_lattice_angle_1.label: Lattice angle 1

sparse_infill_lattice_angle_2.description: The angle of the second set of 2D lattice elements in the Z direction. Zero is vertical.
sparse_infill_lattice_angle_2.label: Lattice angle 2

sparse_infill_line_width.description: Line width of internal sparse infill
sparse_infill_line_width.label: Sparse infill

sparse_infill_pattern.description: Line pattern for internal sparse infill
sparse_infill_pattern.label: Sparse infill pattern

spiral_mode.description: Spiralize smooths out the z moves of the outer contour. And turns a solid model into a single walled print with solid bottom layers. The final generated model has no seam
spiral_mode.label: Spiral vase

spiral_mode_max_xy_smoothing.description: Maximum distance to move points in XY to try to achieve a smooth spiralIf expressed as a %, it will be computed over nozzle diameter
spiral_mode_max_xy_smoothing.label: Max XY Smoothing

spiral_mode_smooth.description: Smooth Spiral smoothes out X and Y moves as wellresulting in no visible seam at all, even in the XY directions on walls that are not vertical
spiral_mode_smooth.label: Smooth Spiral

start_end_points.description: The start and end points which are from cutter area to garbage can.
start_end_points.label: Start end points

sub_top_surface_pattern.description: Line pattern of the solid layer that supports a visible top surface. Its lines can print through and mark the top, so a monotonic pattern gives the smoothest result. The whole solid area that a top surface reaches uses this pattern, not only the part directly beneath it.
sub_top_surface_pattern.label: Sub-top surface pattern

supertack_plate_temp.description: Bed temperature for layers except the initial one. Value 0 means the filament does not support to print on the Cool Plate
supertack_plate_temp.label: Other layers

supertack_plate_temp_initial_layer.description: Bed temperature of the initial layer. Value 0 means the filament does not support to print on the Bambu Cool Plate SuperTack
supertack_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: Initial layer

support_air_filtration.description: Enable this if printer support air filtration enhancement.
support_air_filtration.label: Air filtration enhancement

support_angle.description: Use this setting to rotate the support pattern on the horizontal plane.
support_angle.label: Pattern angle

support_bottom_interface_spacing.description: Spacing of bottom interface lines. Zero means solid interface
support_bottom_interface_spacing.label: Bottom interface spacing

support_bottom_z_distance.description: The z gap between the bottom support interface and object
support_bottom_z_distance.label: Bottom Z distance

support_chamber_temp_control.description: This option is enabled if machine support controlling chamber temperature
support_chamber_temp_control.label: Support control chamber temperature

support_critical_regions_only.description: Only create support for critical regions including sharp tail, cantilever, etc.
support_critical_regions_only.label: Support critical regions only

support_expansion.description: Expand (+) or shrink (-) the horizontal span of normal support
support_expansion.label: Normal Support expansion

support_fast_purge_mode.description: Whether this printer supports fast purge mode with optimized temperature and multiplier.
support_fast_purge_mode.label: Support fast purge mode

support_filament.description: Filament to print support base and raft. "Default" means no specific filament for support and current filament is used
support_filament.label: Support/raft base

support_interface_filament.description: Filament to print support interface. "Default" means no specific filament for support interface and current filament is used
support_interface_filament.label: Support/raft interface

support_interface_loop_pattern.description: Cover the top contact layer of the supports with loops. Disabled by default.
support_interface_loop_pattern.label: Interface use loop pattern

support_interface_not_for_body.description: Avoid using support interface filament to print support base if possible.
support_interface_not_for_body.label: Avoid interface filament for base

support_interface_pattern.description: Line pattern of support interface. Default pattern for support interface is Rectilinear Interlaced
support_interface_pattern.label: Interface pattern

support_interface_spacing.description: Spacing of interface lines. Zero means solid interface.And zero spacing is required to access the enable_support_ironing option
support_interface_spacing.label: Top interface spacing

support_ironing_direction.description: Angle for ironing, which controls the relative angle between the top surface and ironing
support_ironing_direction.label: Support ironing direction

support_ironing_flow.description: The amount of material to extrude during ironing. Relative to flow of normal layer height. Too high value results in overextrusion on the surface
support_ironing_flow.label: Support ironing flow

support_ironing_inset.description: The distance to keep the from the edges of ironing line. 0 means not apply.
support_ironing_inset.label: Support ironing inset

support_ironing_spacing.description: The distance between the lines of ironing
support_ironing_spacing.label: Support ironing line spacing

support_object_first_layer_gap.description: XY separation between an object and its support at the first layer.
support_object_first_layer_gap.label: Support/object first layer gap

support_object_xy_distance.description: XY separation between an object and its support
support_object_xy_distance.label: Support/object xy distance

support_on_build_plate_only.description: Don't create support on model surface, only on build plate
support_on_build_plate_only.label: On build plate only

support_remove_small_overhang.description: Remove small overhangs that possibly need no supports.
support_remove_small_overhang.label: Remove small overhangs

support_style.description:
Style and shape of the support. For normal support, projecting the supports into a regular grid will create more stable supports (default), while snug support towers will save material and reduce object scarring.
For tree support, slim style will merge branches more aggressively and save a lot of material, strong style will make larger and stronger support structure and use more materials, while hybrid style is the combination of slim tree and normal support with normal nodes under large flat overhangs. Organic style will produce more organic shaped tree structure and less interfaces which makes it easer to be removed. The default style is organic tree for most cases, and hybrid tree if adaptive layer height or soluble interface is enabled.
support_style.label: Style

support_threshold_angle.description: Support will be generated for overhangs whose slope angle is below the threshold.
support_threshold_angle.label: Threshold angle

support_top_z_distance.description: The z gap between the top support interface and object
support_top_z_distance.label: Top Z distance

support_type.description: normal(auto) and tree(auto) is used to generate support automatically. If normal(manual) or tree(manual) is selected, only support enforcers are generated
support_type.label: Type

symmetric_infill_y_axis.description: If the model has two parts that are symmetric about the y-axis, and you want these parts to have symmetric textures, please click this option on one of the parts.
symmetric_infill_y_axis.label: Symmetric infill y axis

temperature_vitrification.description: The material softens at this temperature, so when the bed temperature is equal to or greater than it, it's highly recommended to open the front door and/or remove the upper glass to avoid cloggings.
temperature_vitrification.label: Softening temperature

template_custom_gcode.description: This G-code will be used as a custom code
template_custom_gcode.label: Custom G-code

textured_plate_temp.description: Bed temperature for layers except the initial one. Value 0 means the filament does not support to print on the Textured PEI Plate
textured_plate_temp.label: Other layers

textured_plate_temp_initial_layer.description: Bed temperature of the initial layer. Value 0 means the filament does not support to print on the Textured PEI Plate
textured_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: Initial layer

thick_bridges.description: If enabled, bridges are more reliable, can bridge longer distances, but may look worse. If disabled, bridges look better but are reliable just for shorter bridged distances.
thick_bridges.label: Thick bridges

thumbnail_size.description: Decides the size of thumbnail stored in gcode files
thumbnail_size.label: Thumbnail size

timelapse_type.description: If smooth or instant mode is selected, a timelapse video will be generated for each print. After each layer is printed, a snapshot is taken with the chamber camera. All of these snapshots are composed into a timelapse video when printing completes. If smooth mode is selected, the toolhead will move to the excess chute after each layer is printed and then take a snapshot. Since the melt filament may leak from the nozzle during the process of taking a snapshot, prime tower is required for smooth mode to wipe nozzle.
timelapse_type.label: Timelapse

top_area_threshold.description: The min width of top areas in percentage of perimeter line width.
top_area_threshold.label: Top area threshold

top_color_penetration_layers.description: This is  the number of layers of top paint penetration.
top_color_penetration_layers.label: Top paint penetration layers

top_one_wall_type.description: Use only one wall on flat top surface, to give more space to the top infill pattern. Could be applied on topmost surface or all top surface.
top_one_wall_type.label: Only one wall on top surfaces

top_shell_layers.description: This is the number of solid layers of top shell, including the top surface layer. When the thickness calculated by this value is thinner than top shell thickness, the top shell layers will be increased
top_shell_layers.label: Top shell layers

top_shell_thickness.description: The number of top solid layers is increased when slicing if the thickness calculated by top shell layers is thinner than this value. This can avoid having too thin shell when layer height is small. 0 means that this setting is disabled and thickness of top shell is absolutely determained by top shell layers
top_shell_thickness.label: Top shell thickness

top_solid_infill_flow_ratio.description: This factor affects the amount of material for top solid infill. You can decrease it slightly to have smooth surface finish
top_solid_infill_flow_ratio.label: Top surface flow ratio

top_surface_acceleration.description: Acceleration of top surface infill. Using a lower value may improve top surface quality
top_surface_acceleration.label: Top surface

top_surface_density.description: Density of top surface infill, 100% means a fully solid filled top layer.Lower values create a textured top surface, at 0%, only the walls are created on the top layer.Intended for aesthetic or functional purposes, not to fix issues such as over-extrusion.
top_surface_density.label: Top surface density

top_surface_pattern.description: Line pattern of top surface infill
top_surface_pattern.label: Top surface pattern

top_surface_speed.description: Speed of top surface infill which is solid
top_surface_speed.label: Top surface

top_z_overrides_xy_distance.description: When top z distance overrides support/object xy distance, give priority to ensuring that supports are generated beneath overhangs, and a gap of the same size as top z distance is leaved with the model. Whereas in the opposite case, the gap between supports and the model follows support/object xy distance all the time. Only recommended to enable when using HybridTree.
top_z_overrides_xy_distance.label: Z overrides X/Y

travel_acceleration.description: The acceleration of travel except initial layer
travel_acceleration.label: Travel

travel_short_distance_acceleration.description:
Acceleration used for short travel moves near external perimeters. Short travels are moves shorter than the 'Retraction minimum travel' distance.

Lower values (e.g., 250-500 mm/s²) reduce ringing artifacts on sharp corners without significantly impacting print time.

Set to 0 to disable (uses normal travel acceleration).
travel_short_distance_acceleration.label: Short travel

travel_speed.description: Speed of travel which is faster and without extrusion
travel_speed.label: Travel

tree_support_branch_angle.description: This setting determines the maximum overhang angle that t he branches of tree support allowed to make.If the angle is increased, the branches can be printed more horizontally, allowing them to reach farther.
tree_support_branch_angle.label: Branch angle

tree_support_branch_diameter.description: This setting determines the initial diameter of support nodes.
tree_support_branch_diameter.label: Branch diameter

tree_support_branch_diameter_angle.description: The angle of the branches' diameter as they gradually become thicker towards the bottom. An angle of 0 will cause the branches to have uniform thickness over their length. A bit of an angle can increase stability of the tree support.
tree_support_branch_diameter_angle.label: Branch diameter angle

tree_support_branch_distance.description: This setting determines the distance between neighboring tree support nodes.
tree_support_branch_distance.label: Branch distance

tree_support_wall_count.description: This setting specifies the count of support walls in the range of [-1,2]. -1 means auto, and 0 means allowing infill-only mode where support is thick enough.
tree_support_wall_count.label: Support wall loops

use_firmware_retraction.description: Convert the retraction moves to G10 and G11 gcode
use_firmware_retraction.label: Use firmware retraction

use_relative_e_distances.description: If your firmware requires relative E values, check this, otherwise leave it unchecked. Must use relative e distance for Bambu printer
use_relative_e_distances.label: Use relative E distances

vertical_shell_speed.description: Speed for vertical shells with overhang regions. If expressed as percentage (for example: 80%) it will be calculated onthe internal solid infill speed above
vertical_shell_speed.label: Vertical shell speed

wall_distribution_count.description: The number of walls, counted from the center, over which the variation needs to be spread. Lower values mean that the outer walls don't change in width
wall_distribution_count.label: Wall distribution count

wall_generator.description: Classic wall generator produces walls with constant extrusion width and for very thin areas is used gap-fill. Arachne engine produces walls with variable extrusion width
wall_generator.label: Wall generator

wall_loops.description: Number of walls of every layer
wall_loops.label: Wall loops

wall_sequence.description: Print sequence of inner wall and outer wall.
wall_sequence.label: Order of walls

wall_transition_angle.description: When to create transitions between even and odd numbers of walls. A wedge shape with an angle greater than this setting will not have transitions and no walls will be printed in the center to fill the remaining space. Reducing this setting reduces the number and length of these center walls, but may leave gaps or overextrude
wall_transition_angle.label: Wall transitioning threshold angle

wall_transition_filter_deviation.description: Prevent transitioning back and forth between one extra wall and one less. This margin extends the range of extrusion widths which follow to [Minimum wall width - margin, 2 * Minimum wall width + margin]. Increasing this margin reduces the number of transitions, which reduces the number of extrusion starts/stops and travel time. However, large extrusion width variation can lead to under- or overextrusion problems. It's expressed as a percentage over nozzle diameter
wall_transition_filter_deviation.label: Wall transitioning filter margin

wall_transition_length.description: When transitioning between different numbers of walls as the part becomes thinner, a certain amount of space is allotted to split or join the wall segments. It's expressed as a percentage over nozzle diameter
wall_transition_length.label: Wall transition length

wipe.description: Move nozzle along the last extrusion path when retracting to clean leaked material on nozzle. This can minimize blob when printing new part after travel
wipe.label: Wipe while retracting

wipe_distance.description: Describe how long the nozzle will move along the last path when retracting
wipe_distance.label: Wipe Distance

wipe_speed.description: The wipe speed is determined by the speed setting specified in this configuration.If the value is expressed as a percentage (e.g. 80%), it will be calculated based on the travel speed setting above.The default value for this parameter is 80%
wipe_speed.label: Wipe speed

wipe_tower_no_sparse_layers.description: If enabled, the wipe tower will not be printed on layers with no toolchanges. On layers with a toolchange, extruder will travel downward to print the wipe tower. User is responsible for ensuring there is no collision with the print.
wipe_tower_no_sparse_layers.label: No sparse layers (experimental)

xy_contour_compensation.description: Contour of object will be grown or shrunk in XY plane by the configured value. Positive value makes contour bigger. Negative value makes contour smaller. This function is used to adjust size slightly when the object has assembling issue
xy_contour_compensation.label: X-Y contour compensation

xy_hole_compensation.description: Holes of object will be grown or shrunk in XY plane by the configured value. Positive value makes holes bigger. Negative value makes holes smaller. This function is used to adjust size slightly when the object has assembling issue
xy_hole_compensation.label: X-Y hole compensation

z_direction_outwall_speed_continuous.description: Smoothing outwall speed in z direction to get better surface quality. Print time will increases. This does not work on spiral vase mode.
z_direction_outwall_speed_continuous.label: Smoothing wall speed along Z(experimental)

z_hop.description: Whenever the retraction is done, the nozzle is lifted a little to create clearance between nozzle and the print. It prevents nozzle from hitting the print when travel moves. Using spiral line to lift z can prevent stringing
z_hop.label: Z hop when retract
